title: A pilot repository outside KRN delivers five tasks through krn lane run
body:
Why: every KRN task so far is KRN-on-KRN; both audits (Fable, Qwen 4) name an outside pilot as the real product test. Operator 2026-11-11 granted the lead the choice of pilot repository and its onboarding (memory:lead-decides). Decision record: .krn/runs/pilot/decision.md (pick: korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness at /mnt/storage/coding/krn/active/seo-audit).
Outcome: the pilot is onboarded with krn adopt through a PR in its own repository (never pushing its default branch, never editing the operator's checkout), krn lane run delivers 5 real pilot tasks, and their correctness is graded by hidden tests in the t-ahepzts grader shape.
Proof: 5 merged pilot PRs listed with lane $, lead turns and hidden-test verdicts in this task; Qwen N10 portability blockers (App token repositories:['krn'], hard-coded paths) fixed in KRN first.

Token scope (2026-11-11): scripts/github-app-token.ts mints for KRN_APP_REPOSITORY=<owner/name> via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation. Live: korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness answers 404, the App krn-works-delivery is not installed there; the operator installs it (repository-only selection) before krn lane run can push or ship. Remaining N10 items: Check aggregate name (pilot CI is 'CI'), origin/main assumption, npm run fast in lane-run.
Depends on the portability tasks t-9xwtz6f t-p226jft t-pvhs4eb  (operator 2026-11-13: KRN must work in any repository); add a second pilot in another stack (Python) graded the same way.
Portability tasks: t-9xwtz6f contract, t-p226jft Stop check, t-pvhs4eb lane, t-d25znwp adopt, t-0a9xgwe universal skills/rules.

Blocker (2026-11-13, lead): App krn-works-delivery is private (GET /apps/krn-works-delivery unauthenticated: 404), so it can only be installed on the krn-works org; korneliuszburian/seo-audit-harness is a personal-account repo and the bot token gets 404 (git ls-remote: repository not found). No operator token is reachable on this host (gh keyring call answers 'Resource not accessible by integration'). The App bot cannot create krn-works repos (no administration permission). Operator action needed, one of: (1, recommended) App settings > Make public, then install on korneliuszburian with Only select repositories = seo-audit-harness; (2) transfer seo-audit-harness to krn-works (all-repositories installation covers it; old URLs redirect); (3) create an empty private krn-works/krn-pilot repo and the lead seeds it.

Progress 2026-11-13 (lead): N10 check name fixed in #678 (3bb655b): spec/ci-admission.json names any aggregate, krn adopt --ref writes 'ci / Check' and puts the shared CI call in krn-ci.yml beside an existing ci.yml. Origin/main and npm run fast items were already contract-driven (src/cli/pr.ts contractBase, src/cli/lane-run.ts contract.fast). Pilot gate in a local clone (/mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/seo-audit from the operator checkout, stale 94 commits): npm ci 0, npm run verify 1 with 1688/1691 tests passing (2 timeouts under host load, 1 serve profile assertion). Dry adopt in the clone writes the full set with explicit --install/--lint/--typecheck/--test 'npm --prefix packages/seo ...'; auto-detection miss is t-g9m2svp. Remaining: operator App action (Blocker above), then adopt PR in the pilot and 5 lane runs; second stack (Python) pilot not yet picked.

Unblocked 2026-11-13: operator ordered the transfer; the lead moved the pilot with the operator's own gh login to krn-works/seo-audit-harness (private, default main; old URL redirects). App token mint for KRN_APP_REPOSITORY=krn-works/seo-audit-harness exits 0 and git ls-remote answers HEAD 89253e6. Note: scripts/app-bin/gh shadows gh with the krn-scoped App token, so a gh call for another repository answers 404 unless it uses that repository's token.

Adopt PR: krn-works/seo-audit-harness#76 (head 0e18cf5, krn adopt at krn-works/krn@12df9e2: contract auto-detected from packages/seo, KRN CI beside the pilot CI). The App cannot push .github/workflows/* (no workflows permission, by the App grant), so the lead pushed this one bootstrap branch with the operator's gh login (operator-ordered onboarding); later lane PRs touch no workflow files. The base has no spec/ci-admission.json until #76 merges, so #76 itself is watched by check-run conclusions, not krn ci wait.

Pilot #76 CI (head 0e18cf5): ci / Lint, Typecheck pass; ci / Test (1/1) fails 3 of 271 files: (a) tests/cli/monitor-command.test.ts needs packages/seo/dist (install must also run npm --prefix packages/seo run build); (b) tests/repo/consistency.test.ts flags krn options in .agents/skills/delivery-lead/SKILL.md; (c) tests/skills/agent-skills.test.ts requires frontmatter compatibility (>10 chars, contains 'seo'). Pilot tasks picked (reader, evidence docs/research/handoff-audit-unlighthouse-quality-2026-10-07.md:188-195, tool-delivery-roadmap.md:387): 1 empty alt not missing (src/domain/onsite.ts:43 analyzeOnsite), 2 403/429 not broken link (src/domain/findings.ts:155 buildFindings), 3 LCP selector from Lighthouse 12 insight (src/domain/perf-detail.ts:107 extractRouteDetail), 4 sitemap incompleteness reasons (src/domain/sitemap.ts:14 parseSitemap); 5th to pick (candidate sitemapCandidates robots dedupe, sitemap.ts:398, unverified).

Progress 2026-11-13 (lead, session 2): pilot PR krn-works/seo-audit-harness#76 red on 3 files fixed at 752071d: contract test builds first (suite spawns dist/cli/main.js), adopted skills declare compatibility (KRN src/adopt/skills), pilot option/compatibility checks treat krn commands as another tool. Query the pilot as KRN_APP_REPOSITORY=krn-works/seo-audit-harness gh ... (scripts/app-bin/gh mints per repository; a GH_TOKEN override is ignored).

Before the first pilot lane (state review D1, operator 2026-11-13): t-99scx6x Stop refuses nameless failures, t-zgq6c34 canary (broken test in a pilot worktree gives exit 2 from krn hook stop with real vitest), t-ejt6hpt lane installs dependencies, t-1h43kq9 Stop uses contract test in a subdirectory. Pilot main protection requires seo/local-verify, krn/judge-standards, krn/judge-spec (pilot AGENTS.md:62), not ci / Check: PR #76 is green on ci / * but merge-blocked pending the operator's choice.

Progress 2026-11-13 (lead): pilot adopted, krn-works/seo-audit-harness#76 merged 0a94a19 on green ci / Check. Operator chose the faster path: main requires only ci / Check (three local statuses retired, pilot AGENTS.md updated), auto-merge on; krn.json declares install and build-then-test. KRN fixes merged: #684 Stop nameless failures and --prefix paths, #685 lane run install (exit 71) and red-baseline refusal (exit 72), #686 eval overlay. Next: canary t-zgq6c34 (lane paused by quota), then five pilot tasks through krn lane run.

Progress 2026-11-13 (lead, later): gate proven on the pilot. Canary krn adopt /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/adopt --canary: exit 1 before #692, exit 0 after (Stop refuses a broken vitest test with exit 2). krn ci wait on pilot PR 76: exit 0 in 7 s after #691. Rung 0 (#689) keeps the sibling-transplant line (54.3%, CI 42-66%; rung 1 is t-mq1ppm5). Next: five real pilot tasks through krn lane run, each graded by lead-written hidden tests (t-ahepzts shape); first create the five pilot tasks in the pilot repository tracker (tracker: krn in its krn.json).

Lane baselines were red only in linked worktrees: test temp dirs under <worktree>/.krn/tmp resolved git and plan-sample state to the enclosing checkout. Fixed with GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES per test worker and plan-sample treating a .git directory as a main checkout; full npm test green in a linked worktree.
